description_en: Queries a list of created Tensorboard instances
kebab_example: aliyun pai-dlc list-tensorboards --verbose true --workspace-id 380 --source-type job --source-id dlc-xxxxxx --display-name TestTensorboard --status Running --start-time 2020-11-08T16:00:00Z --end-time 2020-11-09T14:45:00Z --sort-by GmtCreateTime --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --order desc --job-id dlc-xxx --tensorboard-id tensorboard-xxx --show-own false --payment-type Postpaid --user-id 16100003000 --username she0000mo --quota-id quota12000 --accessibility PRIVATE --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTensorboards

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to display details.
true: Display details.
false: Do not display details
parameters.help_zh:
是否显示详情。
true：显示详情。
false：不显示详情
parameters.name: verbose

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. Tensorboard instances are filtered by workspace ID. <props="china">Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html to obtain the workspace ID.</props>
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。根据工作空间ID来获取Tensorboard列表。<props="china">参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html获取工作空间ID。</props>
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The data source type. Currently, only DLC training jobs are supported, which means the value is job
parameters.help_zh: 数据来源。目前仅支持DLC训练任务，即job
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The data source ID. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459676.html to obtain the job ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据来源ID。参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459676.html获取任务ID
parameters.name: source_id

parameters.help_en: The display name of the Tensorboard instance
parameters.help_zh: Tensorboard展示名称
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en:
The Tensorboard status. Valid values:
Creating: being created.
Running: running.
Stopped: stopped.
Succeeded: succeeded.
Failed: failed
parameters.help_zh:
Tensorboard状态：
Creating：创建中。
Running：运行中。
Stopped：已停止。
Succeeded：已成功。
Failed：已失败
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query range. Tensorboard instances are filtered by their creation time in UTC. If this parameter is left empty, the default value is 7 days before the current time
parameters.help_zh: 查询区间的起始时间。使用Tensorboard的创建UTC时间来过滤。若为空，则默认为当前时间的7天之前
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query range. Tensorboard instances are filtered by their creation time in UTC. If this parameter is left empty, the default value is the current time
parameters.help_zh: 查询区间的截止时间。使用Tensorboard的创建UTC时间来过滤。若为空，则默认为当前时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The field by which the results are sorted. Valid values:
DisplayName: the job name.
GmtCreateTime: the job creation time
parameters.help_zh:
按返回的以下字段排序。
DisplayName：任务名称。
GmtCreateTime：任务创建时间
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The page number for paging. The value starts from 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询，指定当前需要返回的页码，起始值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of Tensorboard instances to return on each page for paging
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询中，指定每页返回的Tensorboard数量
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:
desc: descending order.
asc: ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序顺序。
desc：降序。
asc：升序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The DLC job ID used to filter Tensorboard instances. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459676.html to obtain the job ID
parameters.help_zh: 根据DLC任务ID来过滤Tensorboard任务。参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459676.html获取任务ID
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The Tensorboard ID used to filter the Tensorboard list
parameters.help_zh: 根据Tensorboard ID，来过滤Tensorboard列表
parameters.name: tensorboard_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return only Tensorboard instances created by the current user
parameters.help_zh: 是否只返回当前登录者所创建的Tensorboard
parameters.name: show_own

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the Tensorboard instance. Valid values:
Free: a Tensorboard instance that uses free resources.
Postpaid: a Tensorboard instance that uses pay-as-you-go resources
parameters.help_zh:
Tensorboard任务的付费类型。
Free代表使用了免费资源的Tensorboard任务。
Postpaid代表使用了后付费资源的Tensorboard任务
parameters.name: payment_type

parameters.help_en: The user ID
parameters.help_zh: 用户ID
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The username
parameters.help_zh: 用户名
parameters.name: username

parameters.help_en:
The resource quota ID.
Currently, only whitelisted users can use resource quota resources to create Tensorboard instances. To use this feature, contact us.
This parameter takes effect only when the Tensorboard instance uses resource quota resources
parameters.help_zh:
资源配额ID。
当前仅白名单用户可以使用资源配额资源创建Tensorboard任务，若需要使用该功能，请和我们联系。
当前仅当Tensorboard任务使用资源配额的资源时，该值有效
parameters.name: quota_id

parameters.help_en:
The visibility of the Tensorboard instance. Valid values:
PUBLIC: visible to all members in the workspace.
PRIVATE: visible only to you and administrators in the workspace
parameters.help_zh:
任务的可见性。
PUBLIC：在此工作空间中，对所有人可见。
PRIVATE：在此工作空间中，仅对您和管理员可见
parameters.name: accessibility
